dedupe_keys.name: global positioning system survey data for active seismic and volcanic areas of eastern sicily 1994 to 2013

description: Global positioning system survey data for active seismic and volcanic areas of eastern Sicily, 1994 to 2013 is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Alessandro Bonforte et al. This work presents and describes a 20-year long database of GPS data collected by geodetic surveys over the seismically and volcanically active eastern Sicily, for a total of more than 6300 measurements. Raw data were initially collected from the various archives at the Istituto Nazionale di Geofisica e Vulcanologia, Sezione di Catania, Osservatorio Etneo and organized in a single repository. Coverage: Sicily (Italy). Formats: ZIP, Image. The data are held in PANGAEA and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Size stated by the repository: 812.7 MBytes. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-3.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support communication-network and digital-infrastructure studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
